basic_details.job_title: NAM Kerala Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.department: State Programme Management and Supporting Unit

age_limit.details: The candidate should be 40 years of age or below as on 01/09/2026.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Any AYUSH Degree recognised by the respective statutory Council, along with a Degree / Postgraduate Diploma in Counselling Courses / Psychology; OR Any AYUSH Degree recognised by the respective statutory Council

qualification.details: Medical Officer - School Health Programme (AYURVIDYA): Any AYUSH Degree recognised by the respective statutory Council, along with a Degree / Postgraduate Diploma in Counselling Courses / Psychology; OR Any AYUSH Degree recognised by the respective statutory Council

how_to_apply: Download the application profile and notification from the official website.
Fill in all relevant fields of the application form carefully with correct details.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates proving age and educational qualifications along with the application.
Enclose the filled application form and certificates in a sealed envelope.

Submit the sealed envelope directly or through post to the State Mission Director, State Programme Management and Supporting Unit, 1st Floor, 82/1827(3), Convent Road, Vanchiyoor, Thiruvananthapuram – 35 on or before 27-10-2026 by 5:00 PM.
important_instructions: Applications received after 5:00 PM on 27-10-2026 will be summarily rejected. Applications submitted in any format other than the provided format will not be accepted. Applications without copies of certificates will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected. Incomplete or incorrect application forms will be summarily rejected. Candidates must possess a personal active E-mail ID and Mobile Number until the completion of the recruitment process. Canvassing in any form will lead to automatic disqualification.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The total number of vacancies for the Medical Officer - School Health Programme (AYURVIDYA) is as per project requirements, and the official notification does not specify a numerical vacancy count.

rows.qualification: Any AYUSH Degree recognised by the respective statutory Council, along with a Degree / Postgraduate Diploma in Counselling Courses / Psychology; OR Any AYUSH Degree recognised by the respective statutory Council
rows.experience: Along with experience in School Health Programmes in a Government Organisation / Department / Mission, etc. (applicable for the second qualification criterion)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 35,700/- per month. The appointment is purely on a contract basis under the AYURVIDYA Project of the National AYUSH Mission, Kerala, and will be subject to the terms and conditions prescribed by the Mission. Selected candidates shall be required to join the project immediately upon receipt of the appointment order.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NAM Kerala Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 27-10-2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary for the NAM Kerala Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a remuneration of Rs. 35,700/- per month.

faq.question: Q3. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The candidate should be 40 years of age or below as on 01/09/2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an AYUSH Degree recognised by the respective statutory Council along with a Degree or Postgraduate Diploma in Counselling Courses or Psychology, or an AYUSH Degree with experience in School Health Programmes in a Government Organisation, Department, or Mission.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline in a sealed envelope either directly or through post.

faq.question: Q6. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to the State Mission Director, State Programme Management and Supporting Unit, 1st Floor, 82/1827(3), Convent Road, Vanchiyoor P.O., Thiruvananthapuram – 35.

faq.question: Q7. Is the job permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is purely on a contract basis under the AYURVIDYA Project of the National AYUSH Mission, Kerala.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process mode?
faq.answer: The mode of recruitment shall be interview, and if there are 20 or more applicants for a particular post, a written test will be conducted along with the interview.
